observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 145.» (L10) and «p. 146.» (L32, beside the head of chapter 43) in the left margin. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the head of chapter 43: 35 stands beside the first line of the title, 40 beside L37.
body L32-L35: the head of the chapter is set in a larger type; «CAPUT XLIII.» is centred, the title is set as a paragraph of three lines, the second and the third indented.
body L32: in the locator «p. 146.» the full stop after p is printed as a faint speck.
body L2, L9: the letters of the references (b) and (c) are bold italic.
body L6: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXI) read «96,6, pro horae, quod cod. et Pl. habent, videtur gradus legendum; cfr. p. 275, adn. 1.»; the printed «horae» is kept.
body L14, L27: the o of «Solis» and the first o of «noctis» are printed thin, like a u.
notes_left L3: ⊙ and ☾ are the signs of the Sun and the Moon; the dash between them is a long dash (7.9 pt).
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
